events.verdict: Powell (MIA) defends Banchero (ORL) in the post, but is not dislodged from his position as a result of the marginal contact.
Bane (ORL) retreats away from Adebayo (MIA) before his shot is blocked near the rim by Carter Jr. (ORL).
Wagner (ORL) legally contests Wiggins' (MIA) jump shot attempt.
Carter Jr. (ORL) establishes a position in Adebayo's (MIA) path and the two players briefly engage and disengage following the screen.
Jaquez Jr. (MIA) lowers his arm down after the release of Suggs' (ORL) shot attempt and any ensuing contact after the release is not illegal.
Carter Jr. (ORL) legally contests Wiggins' (MIA) jump shot attempt.
Adebayo (MIA) dives for the loose ball and makes illegal contact with Bane (ORL) while he is on the floor.
Wiggins (MIA) directly contests Banchero's (ORL) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Banchero's hand after the release.
Adebayo (MIA) makes illegal contact to Carter Jr.'s (ORL) arm after he secures the rebound.
Adebayo (MIA) is off-balance as he receives the pass and Bane (ORL) avoids making any illegal contact during Adebayo's jump shot attempt.
